description: Placeholder starter bindings for a two-stage I2V + LatentSync 1.6 mouth-dubbing pass: animates the shot's still with an I2V model (e.g. LTX or Wan) and re-syncs the mouth with LatentSync 1.6 from the vocal slice. Point comfy.workflows.lipsync at latentsync_lipsync.bindings.json and replace example node ids with ids from your exported workflow. Note: LatentSync weights use the OpenRAIL++ license — review its use restrictions before commercial use.
